ledger.note: Pages and searches tie the project to the Cooper Station gas unit; the cooperative's data center plans are company-wide and name a site near Maysville, not this project.
Kinder Morgan's project page and fact sheet and the South Carolina press piece name no data center demand for the Bridge Project.
The G3 release, earnings material and EIA row name utility shippers and grid reliability; data center talk is company-wide or about other assets.
The Boardwalk release and EIA row name LNG, power and industrial demand for Texas Gateway with no data center mention.
The EIA data center text is for a different Midwestern expansion starting in Illinois, not this 2005 Tennessee Eastern Extension.
The Upper Peninsula line serves local customers; SEMCO's data center pipeline plan is for Dowagiac and is a different project.
The pipeline serves Evergy's Viola plant; Evergy's data center contracts are company-wide and no source ties this project to one.
Filings and press on the Henderson County line name the A.B. Brown plant conversion and no data center.
